services.name: Whooping Crane & Coastal Birding Tour
services.desc: Birding is our passion! Duration 3 Hours About This Texas Boat Safari guarantees you’ll see whooping cranes and we typically point out 30 to 60 different species during our 3-hour trip. We are based right in the middle of one of the best birding areas in the US and our mission is to provide you with the best birding experience possible. You never know what you might see! Capt. Tommy and his experienced guides will teach you as much as you want to learn on how to ID some of the over 400 species that have been documented along the Texas Coastal Bend. services.name: Aransas Bay Dolphin Watching Cruise
services.desc: Dolphin Watching Trips Depart Fulton Harbor in search of Atlantic Bottle-nosed Dolphin on this 1.25 hour cruise. We will spend time watching these amazing creatures very closely as they feed behind the local shrimp fleet. You will see dolphins and birds as well as learn how local shrimp are caught. Duration 1.25 Hours Availability Cruise Runs From Memorial Day Weekend through Labor Day

services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Sunset Cruise running May - September See wildlife and pristine shorelines along San Jose Island before catching the sunset over the bay! We will depart Fulton Harbor and head over to the smooth protected waters along San Jose Island to see nesting birds and other wildlife and then watch the sun set over the bay on this 2 hour cruise. Availability Cruises Run From Memorial Day Weekend through Labor Day

services.name: Spring Rookery Tour
services.desc: On this 4 hour trip we visit 3-4 different rookeries and travel through 6 different bays to witness one of nature's true spectacles. Duration 4 Hours About This is a great opportunity to view many different species of colonial waterbirds courting, sparring, nest-building, and feeding their chicks later in the season.
